title: Open-world people 3: camp's quest givers and the Road West's locals
prompt: A line-up of nine blocky voxel characters at the same scale as the earlier people sheets, each front-on and from the high three-quarter game angle: Argus, camp's huge blond security chief, covered all over in blue eyes (on his arms, neck and face), in a white camp-security polo and khakis with a big ring of keys; Silena Beauregard, a pretty daughter of Aphrodite with long dark hair, pink lip gloss, a pink scarf over her orange camp shirt and a hand mirror; Big Earl, a burly bearded trucker in a red plaid shirt, trucker cap and suspenders holding a rubber chicken; Mrs. Pruitt, a stout New Jersey farm wife in a flowered apron, headscarf and rubber boots with a garden gnome under her arm; Ranger Mae, a cheerful park ranger at the Gateway Arch in a green ranger uniform and flat hat; Chad, a sunburnt teenage ex-lifeguard in red swim shorts, a whistle and an inflatable flamingo floaty; Sal the Valet, a slick Las Vegas valet in a maroon uniform with gold buttons, a pillbox cap and a ring of car keys; Trudy the Tour Guide, a Hollywood tour guide in a sun visor, star-print shirt and a fold-out star map; and Grandma Mae, a tiny old fisherwoman in a yellow raincoat and bucket hat with a fishing rod and a tackle box. 3D game art in the blocky voxel style of Minecraft Dungeons: characters built from cubes, with a large cube head whose face is simple pixel art (about 8 × 8 pixels: pixel eyes, a pixel mouth, hair drawn as pixels and as a few blocky tufts), a boxy torso, square arms and legs, crisp pixel-art textures (about 16 pixels per block) with simple shading, chunky readable silhouettes; warm cinematic lighting, soft ambient occlusion and glowing magic effects. Costume colours and details follow the Camp Half-Blood cartoon concept art. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. Flat light-grey background, no cast shadow. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
